_doc: How tools/audio.py drives the sound engine. RAM names come from ram.inc. A song starts the way PlayQueuedSounds does it in VBlank: PlayMusic with the song in A (it resets the engine and starts the song's two to four parts); a sound effect through PlaySound, which leaves the music running. UpdateSound runs once per frame from the VBlank handler. Six channel records of 26 bytes at wSoundChannels: 0-1 for the sound effects, 2-5 for the music; a channel is free while its event number (bytes 0 and 25) is $FFFF.

music.label: Music
music._playing: the event numbers (bytes 0 and 25) of the six channel records: $FF in both = free

loop_channels._doc: the six channel records: event number (bytes 0 and 25) and the two loop counters (bytes 10-11); a channel whose byte 25 is $FF is free
